method.intent: Treat each supplied 2D reference image as an independent design brief, then rebuild receiver, transmitter, maritime communication ship, and LEO satellite as separate inspectable Three.js objects instead of one combined scene.
steps: Read one reference image at a time and isolate the dominant engineering object.
Convert the object into named components, review layers, and semantic connections.
Render each model as procedural Three.js geometry with its own scale, camera target, and labels.
Expose a model switcher so each image2-to-3D result can be reviewed independently.
Run a quality gate that checks all four independent reconstructions.

models.name: Transmitter image2-to-3D
models.summary: Independent 3D reconstruction of a transmitter cabinet with RF rack, feeder lines, power path, cooling vents, and directional antenna.
models.chain: Baseband input -> RF power rack -> feeder -> directional antenna

models.name: Receiver image2-to-3D
models.summary: Independent 3D reconstruction of a receiver terminal with receiving antenna, low-noise RF chain, rack modules, decoder, power shelf, and monitoring indicators.
models.chain: receiving antenna -> low-noise chain -> receiver rack -> decoder output

components.label: Signal decoder
components.role: converts RF/IF signal into data output

models.name: Maritime Communication Ship image2-to-3D
models.summary: Independent 3D reconstruction of the supplied maritime communication ship image: long blue hull, red waterline, white bridge, window bands, railings, lattice communication mast, radomes, large satellite dish, aft crane, open equipment bays, colored cable harnesses, and ocean wake.
models.chain: shipboard gateway -> mast antennas -> satellite / shore link

components.label: Long blue vessel hull with red waterline
White bridge and window bands
components.role: multi-level command deck matching the reference silhouette

components.label: Deck railings and forward winch
components.role: visible ship deck details and scale cues

components.label: Tall lattice communication mast
components.role: mounts whip antennas, radomes, radar, and relay equipment

components.label: Large satellite dish and radar set
Open shipboard gateway equipment bays
components.role: routing, RF processing, and power distribution

components.label: Visible colored cable harnesses
components.role: signal, power, and grounding routes exposed in side equipment bays

components.label: Aft deck crane boom
components.role: rear service equipment visible in the supplied image

models.name: LEO Satellite image2-to-3D
models.summary: Independent 3D reconstruction of a low-Earth-orbit communication satellite with bus, solar wings, payload boxes, parabolic antenna, harnesses, and Earth limb reference.
models.chain: solar arrays -> satellite bus -> payload processor -> directional antenna

components.label: Satellite bus
components.role: structural, attitude, power, and thermal platform

components.label: Communication payload modules
components.role: transponder, beam control, and channel processing

components.label: Payload antenna
components.role: directional link toward ground or maritime users

components.label: External harnesses
components.role: power and signal routes across satellite panels

components.label: Earth limb reference
components.role: orbit context for the reconstructed spacecraft
